title: Remote
subtitle: Run the AI sessions you already use, from anywhere
description:
Connect Sylo to the AI you already use, like Claude or Codex, and run its sessions from anywhere.

See every session on your computers from your phone or the web, and how each one is going. Open one to read what it has done so far, answer when it asks, or send it your own words. Start a new session in a folder you chose, stop it mid-task, or end it when you are done.

When a session asks to run something, the question comes to you, and Sylo can say no for you. Nothing runs without your tap, and a session never works outside the folders you chose.

reaches.why: To show what each is doing and read what it did.
To start a session there, and nowhere else.

never: Works outside the folders you chose
Allows a tool without your tap
